svg.title: RFDPO: reflective feedback-driven prompt optimization
svg.desc: Mining and validation guide iterative prompt revision. Measured item transitions feed subsequent rewrites. All valid changed candidates are retained, the best committed candidate is selected by validation, and test data are excluded from feedback and selection.

text.tspan: RFDPO: revise prompts using the measured effects of previous edits
M + V transitions; prior edited text
Up to 3 rounds; each changed candidate becomes the next parent.
Prompt versions, item outcomes, scores and call ledger
